name: Danganronpa: Ultimate Liar
source:
Sixteen students find themselves trapped together, with their supplies quickly running out: food, clean water, power, and even air.

Unlike the classic killing game, their memories were never erased. They still remember the close bonds they formed at Hope's Peak Academy. When the only way to survive is to murder someone you care about, can friendship survive the desperation?

[From [url=https://darkstorylab.itch.io/danganronpa-ultimate-liar]itch.io[/url]]
